decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel remains central to the firm's strategy of binding mobile communication, and with the industry growing there is no performance shortfall that would trigger problemistic search.

The multi-layer architecture describes the integrated portfolio itself, so dropping it would free few resources, even though its absence from the website after 2019 suggests it may since have been folded into broader messaging.

Customers' shift toward app-based authentication likely pushes the QR hardware token below aspiration, but regulated clients still need hardware options and slack allows the firm to carry it a while longer.
The payment compliance suite fits the firm's regulatory value proposition but sits at the edge of the identity core, so a shortfall could redirect its resources, though for now it is kept.
